label: NATIVE (ODG GO dispatch)
nativeClaim: a PASS means: from a problem DERIVED BY ODG RULES (executed failing cases vs the in-repo reference — no provider-written algorithm in any prompt), ODG's LOCAL MODEL proposed ≥2 designs, ODG selected one mechanically on sandbox-measured scores, the local model implemented it, and ODG tested/repaired/typechecked it. The INPUT corpus (ORC-2 literals), the prompt templates and the runner are provider-written

diversity.rule: DIV-1: a generation whose sandbox content equals one already seen in the run is a STALL; on a stall the ladder advances one pre-declared point — sampling steps (temperature, seed) on the current design, then the next design in SEL-1 order (its S4 implementation reused first, no call), then larger registered local models — at most maxVariations advances; every call within the same maxModelCalls; an identical (prompt, model, temperature 0, seed) call already sent is NOT re-sent (deterministic ⇒ counted as a stall, no budget spent); ladder exhausted ⇒ the identical generation stands (buildProject NO_PROGRESS)
diversity.escalationBasis: docs/odg/evidence/V155_OLLAMA_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.json: no AVAILABLE model larger than qwen2.5-coder:7b (7.6B; others 3.1B, 494.03M) ⇒ no MODEL_ESCALATION point

problem.rule: PROB-1: execute the CURRENT module and the in-repo REFERENCE on the corpus; failing = output ≠ reference; reference output not valid JSON ⇒ excluded; SHOWN = first failing case per kind (+ one more per lesson kind tag), rest HELD OUT

impact.rule: IMP-1 change-impact-graph.impactOf (consumers / closure / hazards) + IMP-2 *.test.ts in runtime/core|bin that require the module (impactOf.impactedTests scans *.test.js only)

host.rule: HOST-1: loadavg-1m and nproc are recorded before EVERY model call (warm-up included); the run refuses to START (NOT_MEASURED, no model call) when loadavg-1m > nproc×idleFactor. A later reading above the threshold is recorded (hostLoadAboveThreshold) but does not stop the run: the model server's own inference raises loadavg-1m, so a mid-run reading cannot separate ODG's load from a concurrent one
